shared_elements: low-relief incised symbolic motifs on an upright surface
justification: Both surfaces show human-like figures and a prominent circular disc rendered in shallow incised relief on a tall upright monument, but these are near-universal features. A is a single massive figure in the round with motifs distributed over its body (headdress, chest disc, belt-like bands), while B is a flat panel organised into a winged-disc lunette, a horizontal register of small facing profile figures, and multiple ruled lines of sign-writing — none of which appears in A.
